say:1:1122520001:1.text: A caravan needs an escort out of Alkali. They said they wanted the best bounty hunter in town.
say:1:1122520001:1.source_cn: 有个商队想请人护送他们离开咸水镇，点明了要基地里最厉害...

say:2:1122520002:1.text: Other than myself, I guess you could fit that lofty title. So, how about it? You interested?
say:2:1122520002:1.source_cn: 除了我，基地里只有你勉强够得上这称号。\n怎么样，有兴趣吗？
say:2:1122520002:1.male: Other than myself, I guess you could fit that lofty title. So, how about it? You interested?
say:2:1122520002:1.female: Other than myself, I guess you could fit that lofty title. So, how about it? You interested?

say:3:1122520003:1.text: They're stationed just <style="highlight">south of Alkali</style>. You'll see them when you make your way there.
say:3:1122520003:1.source_cn: 他们就驻扎在<style=highlight>咸水镇南...
